response.sql: WITH site_avgs AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS face_avg FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(face_avg) AS overall_avg FROM site_avgs), status_avgs AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(face_avg) AS status_avg FROM site_avgs WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept AS (SELECT sa.face_avg, b.overall_avg, st.status_avg FROM site_avgs AS sa JOIN status_avgs AS st ON st.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND sa.face_avg > st.status_avg) SELECT AVG(face_avg) AS avg_faces, AVG(face_avg - overall_avg) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(face_avg - status_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Only exceeding the access status average determines which sites are kept. The difference from the overall baseline is signed and can be negative.

alternatives.interpretation: If 'exceed the overall baseline' also means kept sites must be strictly above that baseline, apply both thresholds.
